references.title: Predicting and improving complex beer flavor through machine learning
claims: Sections on chemical analysis and pairwise sensory correlations discuss shared fermentation patterns and unexpected associations of ethyl octanoate/decanoate with hop perception and bitterness.
The model-dissection section describes ethyl acetate as fruity/solvent/alcoholic and lactic acid as contributing tart taste.
references.support_boundary: 本题附件主要源自同一研究，不能作为本样本关联的独立外部重复验证；研究中的加标结果也不验证全部135个Top-3位置。

references.title: The Contribution of Geraniol Metabolism to the Citrus Flavour of Beer: Synergy of Geraniol and β-Citronellol Under Coexistence with Excess Linalool
references.journal: Journal of the Institute of Brewing
claims: Beer sensory experiments found combined geraniol and β-citronellol made excess linalool more fruity/citrus; coexistence of the three compounds supported synergy.
references.support_boundary: 支持特定试验基质中的单萜醇协同，不提供每一种萜烯对任意感官项的直接机制，也不能将试验浓度直接作为通用阈值。

references.title: Influence of Ethyl Acetate, Isoamyl Acetate and Linalool on off-flavour Perception in Beer
claims: The paper describes cabbage-like DMS and buttery diacetyl and tests their perception in lager beer.
Ester and linalool additions changed DMS/diacetyl thresholds; effects depended on compound and concentration.
references.support_boundary: 该来源支持缺陷感知和基质交互；没有检验本题DMS感官Top-3的松油烯-4-醇、E-橙花叔醇等候选，不能据其认定相关候选可消除缺陷。DOI未在所核实出版者页面给出。

references.title: Key constituents, flavour profiles and specific sensory evaluation of wheat style non-alcoholic beers depending on their production method
references.journal: Journal of the Institute of Brewing
claims: Table 2 reports GC-O/MS odor qualities including banana for isoamyl acetate, clove for 4-vinylguaiacol, floral/citrus for linalool, and fruity/glue for ethyl octanoate.
The same table identifies acidic acetic acid and several fruity esters; the study emphasizes matrix/process dependence.
references.support_boundary: 嗅闻口气味与特定啤酒样本提供定性依据；不等于这些物质对本题45个评分的因果系数或原量尺校准。未据气味表验证辛酸乙酯产生苦味。

references.title: Release of Deuterated Nonenal during Beer Aging from Labeled Precursors Synthesized in the Boiling Kettle
references.journal: Journal of Agricultural and Food Chemistry
claims: Labeled-precursor experiments linked nonenal release during aging to cardboard flavor and reversible associations formed during wort boiling.
references.support_boundary: 支持反式-2-壬烯醛与老化纸板味的联系；不支持本题nonenal浓度同酒花香正相关的直接机制，也不将Trans-2-nonenal与Stale hops两个感官项合并。

evidence_categories.direct: 同一化合物与相应感官描述有气味/嗅闻/加标证据；不代表本样本中的相关已被证实为因果。
evidence_categories.general: 已核实化合物的其他气味或一般化学背景；未支持本行目标感官的直接机制。
evidence_categories.indirect: 有共变/共同来源或复杂感官联系的依据，仅作代理或假说；可能包含对同一原研究的复核，非独立重复。
evidence_categories.unverified: 本次核实的一级文献未支持该化合物—目标感官关联，附件元数据仍可追溯。

data_boundary: 135行按sensory_target+rank+compound与冻结top3_compounds.csv一一对应。附件8分类和阈值是元信息，不是本次新增实验。
threshold_note: 阈值列原样转录附件元数据，单位、基质与测定口径未一律统一，不据此直接计算相对谱的气味活度值。

claim_registry.claim: 原研究将酯类及多种醇类作为共同发酵来源讨论；可形成工艺/风格共变标记。
claim_registry.boundary: 间接共变解释，不证明本行麦芽或酯类具体气味由该物质直接产生。

claim_registry.claim: 原研究说明乳酸贡献酸啤酒的酸味。

claim_registry.boundary: 相同气味描述的定性依据，非本样本关联的干预验证。

claim_registry.claim: GC-O/MS报告果香/胶样气味；原研究报告同酒花感知和苦味的意外关联。
claim_registry.boundary: 原研究与本题共享数据，非独立重复；未证明该酯直接产生酒花香或苦味。

claim_registry.claim: 同位素研究支持老化期间反式-2-壬烯醛释放与纸板味相关。
claim_registry.boundary: 本行目标为酒花感官，不能由纸板味证据解释其正相关，也不能与Stale hops等同。

claim_registry.boundary: 同源数据的背景说明，非独立的直接气味/抑制机制验证。

claim_registry.boundary: 三组分交互依赖基质；不支持其他目标（如t2n）的直接抑制机制。

claim_registry.boundary: 三组分交互依赖基质；不支持其他目标（如t2n）的直接抑制机制。
